payload.body_they: {{Name}} needs enough privacy and consistency at home to understand what they are feeling without constantly responding to everyone else first. Familiar routines and knowing when their time is actually their own can matter more than people realize. Familiarity can also keep an arrangement going long after it stops working. Home becomes more supportive when care, privacy, access, money, and responsibility are things the people living there can actually discuss and change.
